Chapter 377: Chapter 3 Seventh-Level Citizen (Subscribe please)_2

“`

“I am now a king of the Seventh Rank, but with such a vast Inner World, ordinary Eighth Layer Evolvers wouldn’t stand a chance against me…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even upon reaching the Eighth Layer, he would master many of the methods exclusive to Eighth Layer Evolvers,

but Lin Yuan’s Inner World was so vast, its worldly power so immense, that he could overpower craftiness with brute strength,

unless someone had an Inner World of the same tier, facing Lin Yuan, they could only flee.

...

“Next, I should try to break through to the Eighth Layer.”

“Before that, I should strengthen my Spirit Will as much as possible, to better face the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’.”

Lin Yuan’s goal was clear; with his current foundation, if not for the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’, he could easily break through now.

“To enhance Spirit Will, the common approach of Human Civilization is to experience more, to simply live on.”

“But this is just the common way; there are many other methods that can fortify the strength of one’s Spirit Will…”

Although Lin Yuan could take a shortcut to pass the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ with the help of the Door to the Myriad Realms,

such a method was not secure. Even if Lin Yuan used it, he would wait until he was confident enough to attempt it.

Try casually?

To undergo the Heart Demon Tribulation without preparation, if the Door to the Myriad Realms couldn’t isolate the ‘Heart Demon’, wouldn’t it be seeking death?

How to pass the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ is of utmost importance to human Evolvers.

Once the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ is failed, death is certain, with no chance for ‘resurrection’.

Because the essence of the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ stems from one’s own spirit, even if a Supreme Being intervened, forcefully resuscitating the body, one would still be in the state of undergoing the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’.

By then, death would still ensue.

Because you cannot pass through it.

Even if a Supreme Being intervened, they could save your Physical Soul or even True Spirit Consciousness, but they couldn’t dispel the ‘Heart Demon’.

The ‘Heart Demon’ is still there, and as long as you can’t get through it, you will die no matter how many times you are resurrected.

In front of one’s own ‘Heart Demon’, even the offspring of Supreme Beings are equal to all living beings.

“It’s about time.”

“I should go out and see my teacher now…”

Lin Yuan’s insight into the Space Rules had long alerted him to the fact that the space outside had been completely isolated from normal space, probably due to the Chikun Star Lord’s actions to conceal the expansion of his Inner World.

The reason Lin Yuan asked the Chikun Star Lord to help conceal it was that, even though opening an Inner World at the Seventh Rank was astonishing and defied the heavens in the eyes of the outside world,

Even more so because the fluctuations of the Inner World Lin Yuan had just revealed were far from being as simple as a newly opened Inner World.

So it was better to keep it concealed, if possible.

There was no choice, the experiences on the Battlefields of Different Races had made Lin Yuan wary.

If it were a normal breakthrough, even to the Eighth Layer, Lin Yuan would not have been so cautious, but possessing an Inner World that spanned more than a hundred thousand miles at the Seventh Rank was indeed unimaginable.

…

Stepping out of the great hall,

Lin Yuan saw that the Chikun Star Lord had been waiting for a long time.

“Is everything all right?”

The Chikun Star Lord looked at Lin Yuan and asked.

“Everything is fine.” Lin Yuan nodded.

“My good disciple, you really do surprise me…” The Chikun Star Lord shook his head, his tone filled with emotion.

“What level have you reached in your understanding of the core space models?”

The Chikun Star Lord continued to inquire.

“Core space models…” Lin Yuan knew he couldn’t hide from the Chikun Star Lord and told the truth, “Not quite twelve hundred.”

In fact, if it weren’t for the last two hundred years in the Tianqing World, where Lin Yuan had given up on comprehending the Space Rules, he estimated the number of core space models he could have understood might have reached fifteen hundred.

“Twelve hundred… not yet…” The Chikun Star Lord sighed.

This remark seemed somewhat deflated.

“Teacher, I’ve recently found that the deeper I go, the slower the comprehension of core space models becomes, and the more often I hit bottlenecks…”

Lin Yuan immediately said.

“….”

The Chikun Star Lord fell silent.

“It’s normal.”

The Chikun Star Lord couldn’t help but say.

“For you to grasp twelve hundred core space models at this age, it’s already rare… extremely rare…”

The Chikun Star Lord said softly, “If it weren’t confirmed by the three goddesses, I would doubt whether you had been subjected to ‘seizure’ by one of the Alien Strong Ones…”

Lin Yuan smiled, “Seizure?”

Indeed, like the Chikun Star Lord who could seize the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, other alien strong ones could also seize human Evolvers.

However, Lin Yuan’s soul, having been verified repeatedly by the three goddesses, belonged to humans beyond doubt and was not of a Different Species.

“You have too powerful a talent for perception…” The Chikun Star Lord finally voiced his own feelings.

“`

“`

For the longest time, the Chikun Star Lord was described by others in such terms, since with the body of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, the Chikun Star Lord’s understanding of the Space Rules had always been peerless.

“I might just be lucky.”

Lin Yuan said.

“Can luck always be on your side?” the Chikun Star Lord shook his head.

“However, now that you have created your Inner World, the next focus should be on the Spirit Will.” The Chikun Star Lord’s expression became slightly more solemn.

For an ultimate genius Evolver like Lin Yuan, there was a greater possibility of stumbling over the Spirit Will, in the Heart Demon Tribulation.

Because everything had gone too smoothly in the beginning, without the slightest setback, one might subconsciously think little of the Heart Demon Tribulation.

After all, from Seventh to Eighth Layer, it is widely acknowledged that creating the Inner World is the hardest part, and even the most ordinary Evolver can possibly overcome the Heart Demon Tribulation.

However, once this thought arose, problems could surface.

In the over two million years of the Starry Sea Era, countless Evolving genius talents had fallen at the Heart Demon Tribulation.

“I know.”

Lin Yuan nodded, he had never underestimated the Heart Demon Tribulation.

“Although it’s difficult to measure Spirit Will, over the many years, our Human Civilization has still summarized a set of standards to roughly estimate it, and I will send them to you later.”

The Chikun Star Lord said.

This set of standards, even within the Human Civilization Alliance, is considered ‘top secret’, as it could easily be applied by Different Species.

Therefore, only a Star Domain master like the Chikun Star Lord possessed the specifics, which Lin Yuan could not see in either the Virtual World or the Chikun Treasury.

…

After seeing off the Chikun Star Lord,

Lin Yuan returned to the great hall.

“Inner World…”

Lin Yuan was getting acquainted with the power of the Inner Time, after all, his Inner World, which had expanded explosively to a radius of 120,000 li, was filled with the vast World Power.

“Hm?”

“Someone’s looking for me?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and accessed the virtual panel.

“Shi Feng?”

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World.

Soon, a red-nosed old man appeared.

It was his good friend from the Virtual World founders’ circle.

Shi Feng.

It was Shi Feng who had helped him at the Annan Star Alliance conference, trading away his voting rights.

“Hahaha, Brother Shisan, the Star Alliance conference is approaching. Don’t forget to attend…”

The red-nosed Shi Feng said with a laugh.

“Of course.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had received benefits from the Wangyue Starfield, so naturally, he wouldn’t forget.

As for the threat from Jin Tianzhao of the Golden Dragon Star Domain, Lin Yuan didn’t take it to heart at all.

Let alone Jin Tianzhao, even the Golden Dragon Star Master wouldn’t dare to act against a Sixth-Level Citizen.

Lin Yuan chatted with the red-nosed Shi Feng for a while.

Then he disconnected from the Virtual World and his consciousness returned to reality.

“Speaking of which, I now have enough Merit Points to upgrade to a Seventh-Level Citizen…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

From Sixth-Level to Seventh-Level Citizen, two million Merit Points are needed.

Lin Yuan had thought that this was a far-off goal, one that would take several journeys to accumulate enough points.

Yet, just one journey and uploading the Seventh Rank Chapter had earned him three million Merit Points.

The main reason was that the Seventh Rank Chapter involved creating the Inner World and was highly rated by the three goddesses.

“Let’s upgrade.”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly.

In an instant, more than three million Merit Points in Lin Yuan’s account decreased by two million.

At the same time,

Lin Yuan’s Citizen rank was upgraded from the original Sixth-Level to Seventh-Level.

“Seventh-Level Citizen!!”

Lin Yuan’s spirit shook slightly. One should know that ordinary Eighth Layer Evolvers hadn’t reached the Seventh-Level Citizen rank, as Merit Points were not that easy to accumulate.

Before Lin Yuan could reflect further,

a series of emails from the Central Star Domain arrived, introducing the many privileges of a Seventh-Level Citizen.
